note: Every program below is verified against official provider documentation. Availability, pricing, and eligibility are decided solely by each provider and can change; check official terms before applying.

items.name: Charity OS (by Charitology)
items.offer: Free, open-source shared back-office workspace covering 26 modules: programs, grants, volunteers, approvals, and frozen board/funder reports with full JSON export.
items.eligibility: Open to any charity or nonprofit team worldwide; no verification gate or vendor lock-in.

items.name: Google Workspace for Nonprofits (with Gemini)
items.offer: Free Google Workspace for Nonprofits core suite (custom-domain Gmail, Drive, Docs, Meet, Calendar, and included Gemini features) plus 70%+ discounts on Business & Enterprise editions.
items.eligibility: Registered charitable nonprofits in eligible countries; schools, hospitals, and government bodies follow separate education/public-sector tracks.

items.name: OpenAI for Nonprofits
items.offer: ChatGPT Business Standard at $8/user/month billed annually ($10 monthly), plus up to 75% off ChatGPT Enterprise for larger organizations.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits globally; API usage credits and premium add-ons are generally excluded from the standard seat discount.

items.name: Anthropic — Claude for Nonprofits
items.offer: Up to 75% off Claude Team ($8/user/month, or down to $3/user/month in qualifying lower-income regions; 2-seat minimum) and Claude Enterprise ($10/user/month), plus AI Fluency for Nonprofits training.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits worldwide via Goodstack.

items.name: Microsoft 365 & Copilot for Nonprofits
items.offer: Up to 300 free Microsoft 365 Business Basic licenses (web/mobile Office, Exchange email, Teams, SharePoint) plus nonprofit discounts on Business Standard, Business Premium, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits meeting Microsoft's mission and anti-discrimination eligibility rules.

items.name: Google Ad Grants
items.offer: Up to $10,000/month in free in-kind Google Search text ads to attract donors, volunteers, and service seekers.
items.eligibility: Eligible verified charities with a live, high-quality website; accounts must maintain ongoing policy compliance and minimum click-through/conversion standards.

items.name: YouTube Nonprofit Program
items.offer: YouTube Giving Donate buttons on videos and livestreams where YouTube covers transaction processing fees (100% reaches the charity), plus interactive external link cards.
items.eligibility: Active Google for Nonprofits account and compliant verified YouTube channel (channels marked 'Made for Kids' are ineligible).

items.name: Zeffy
items.offer: Zero-fee fundraising forms, event ticketing, peer-to-peer campaigns, memberships, and auctions; Zeffy covers both platform and card-processing fees via optional donor contributions.
items.eligibility: Registered nonprofits in supported regions (U.S., Canada, and expanding markets); donors see an optional tip prompt at checkout.

items.name: PayPal Giving Fund
items.offer: 0% platform and transaction fees for enrolled charities receiving donations through PayPal's app/website, GoFundMe, and partner fundraising platforms.
items.eligibility: Enrolled 501(c)(3) public charities (and supported international charity programs); disbursements arrive as unrestricted grants.

items.name: Givebutter
items.offer: Free core fundraising platform, donor CRM, donation forms, auctions, and events when optional donor tips are enabled.
items.eligibility: Open to nonprofits and charitable campaigns; optional Givebutter Plus add-ons are paid.

items.name: Stripe Nonprofit Fee Discount
items.offer: Lower card-processing fee rates for qualifying charitable organizations compared with standard commercial Stripe pricing.
items.eligibility: Must hold valid tax-exempt status and process at least 80% of total account payment volume as tax-deductible donations (tickets, tuition, and memberships do not count toward the 80%; AmEx excluded).

items.name: Salesforce Power of Us
items.offer: 10 donated Salesforce Enterprise Edition licenses in an approved nonprofit product bundle, plus deep discounts on additional seats.
items.eligibility: Qualified 501(c)(3) and international equivalents; plan realistically for setup, administration, and possible consultant costs.
items.verification: Direct Salesforce Power of Us application

items.name: CiviCRM
items.offer: Free, open-source constituent relationship manager for donors, memberships, grants, events, and mailings with full data ownership.
items.eligibility: Open source for any organization; budget separately for web hosting, backups, and technical maintenance.

items.name: QuickBooks Online (via TechSoup)
items.offer: Heavily discounted annual access to QuickBooks Online Plus and QuickBooks Online Advanced via a TechSoup administrative fee instead of standard monthly retail pricing.
items.eligibility: Qualifying 501(c)(3) public charities and eligible international equivalents through TechSoup.

items.name: Donorbox
items.offer: No monthly fee on the Standard starter plan for embeddable recurring donation forms; platform and payment-processing fees apply per donation (donors can optionally cover fees).
items.eligibility: Open to nonprofits worldwide; higher-tier CRM/automation plans add monthly charges.

items.name: Cloudflare Project Galileo
items.offer: Free enterprise-grade unmetered DDoS mitigation, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Bot Management, CDN caching, and Zero Trust security.
items.eligibility: High-risk, budget-constrained civil society, human rights, democracy, arts, and independent journalism organizations facing targeted cyber threats.
items.verification: Civil-society partner referral or direct Cloudflare intake

items.name: Okta for Good
items.offer: 50 free Okta Workforce Identity Cloud licenses (Single Sign-On & Multi-Factor Authentication), 50% off additional seats and Auth0 Customer Identity Cloud, plus pro bono technical coaching.
items.eligibility: Verified 501(c)(3) or international equivalents via Goodstack; hospitals, schools, and government agencies are generally excluded.

items.name: GitHub for Nonprofits
items.offer: Free GitHub Team plan for qualifying nonprofit organizations (unlimited repositories, team access controls, GitHub Actions, and Pages).
items.eligibility: Registered charities and nonprofits verified via Goodstack or TechSoup.

items.name: Microsoft Azure Nonprofit Grant
items.offer: Annual Azure cloud credit sponsorship to run servers, databases, storage, and AI workloads on Microsoft Azure.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits registered through Microsoft Nonprofits; credits renew annually subject to current Microsoft program terms.

items.name: AWS Nonprofit Credit Program (via TechSoup)
items.offer: $1,000 to $5,000 in promotional AWS cloud credits (one grant per fiscal year, July 1–June 30) covering on-demand compute, storage, and databases.
items.eligibility: Eligible nonprofits and public libraries via TechSoup (small TechSoup administrative fee applies); excludes AWS Marketplace, Enterprise Support, and training.

items.name: AWS Imagine Grant
items.offer: Competitive public grant awarding unrestricted cash funding, AWS promotional credits, and technical support (including AWS Generative AI Innovation Center access).
items.eligibility: Registered charities in participating countries (U.S., Canada, UK, Australia, New Zealand, and more); traditional schools and universities sit in separate AWS education tracks.

items.name: Sentry for Good
items.offer: Free sponsored Business-equivalent Sentry account for real-time application error tracking, logs, and performance monitoring.
items.eligibility: Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits and international equivalents applying directly.

items.name: Datadog Observability for Good
items.offer: Free cloud monitoring, metrics, and log-ingest allowance for qualifying nonprofit and NGO engineering teams (plus a separate Open Source program).
items.eligibility: Registered nonprofits and NGOs approved directly by Datadog.

items.name: 1Password for Nonprofits
items.offer: Discounted 1Password Business plans for shared credential security, often bundling free individual 1Password Families accounts for staff.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits applying through 1Password's nonprofit team.

items.name: Box.org
items.offer: Donated Box Starter seats or at least 50% off Box Business and Enterprise secure cloud document management and e-signatures.
items.eligibility: TechSoup-validated charities; excludes government agencies, hospitals, schools, and credit unions.

items.name: Dropbox for Nonprofits (via TechSoup)
items.offer: 40% discount on annual Dropbox Standard and Advanced team subscriptions via TechSoup.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable organizations redeeming through TechSoup.

items.name: JetBrains Nonprofit & Open Source
items.offer: 25%–50% off commercial IDE licenses for registered nonprofits; free All Products Pack for active open-source project maintainers.
items.eligibility: Paid nonprofit staff require a discounted commercial license (not a personal non-commercial license); open-source licenses require a public OSS repo.

items.name: WordPress (Open Source)
items.offer: Free, open-source website CMS powering millions of charity websites with full theme and plugin control.
items.eligibility: Open source for anyone; budget separately for domain registration, hosting, and backups.

items.name: Slack for Nonprofits
items.offer: Free Slack Pro for eligible workspaces with 250 or fewer members; 85% off Pro above 250 members or Business+ at any size.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits via Goodstack/TechSoup; political, educational, and hospital restrictions apply.

items.name: monday.com for Nonprofits
items.offer: 10 free seats on the monday.com Pro plan, 70% off every additional seat past 10, and 33% off Enterprise.
items.eligibility: Registered charities, NGOs, and social-change nonprofits submitting official registration documents.

items.name: Loom for Nonprofits (via Atlassian)
items.offer: 100% off Loom Business and Business + AI async video messaging for up to 25 users, and 75% off for teams of 26+ users.
items.eligibility: Verified nonprofits applying through Atlassian's nonprofit community licensing program.

items.name: Atlassian for Nonprofits (Jira & Confluence)
items.offer: 75% off Atlassian Cloud subscriptions (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management) for qualifying charities, plus free standard tiers for teams of up to 10.
items.eligibility: Registered non-governmental, non-academic, non-commercial, non-political charitable organizations.

items.name: Trello for Nonprofits
items.offer: 75% off Trello Standard and Premium kanban project boards through Atlassian's nonprofit licensing program (in addition to Trello's free plan).
items.eligibility: Registered qualifying charitable nonprofits.

items.name: Notion for Nonprofits
items.offer: 50% off the Notion Plus workspace plan for verified nonprofits (in addition to Notion's free plan for solo/small usage).
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits via Goodstack.

items.name: Asana for Nonprofits
items.offer: 50% off annual Asana Starter or Advanced work-management plans for eligible nonprofits.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable organizations via Goodstack.

items.name: Airtable for Nonprofits
items.offer: 50% discount on Airtable Team plans for relational grant, volunteer, and program tracking.
items.eligibility: Qualifying registered charitable nonprofits.

items.name: Miro for Nonprofits
items.offer: 30% discount on Miro Starter and Business collaborative whiteboard plans, plus Miro's free starter tier.
items.eligibility: Verified charitable nonprofits.

items.name: Zoom for Nonprofits
items.offer: 50% off selected annual Zoom Workplace Pro, Business, Large Meeting, and Webinar plans.
items.eligibility: Eligible nonprofits validated via TechSoup (small TechSoup admin fee applies).

items.name: Nextcloud Files
items.offer: Free open-source self-hosted cloud file sharing, collaborative docs, calendars, and contacts with full privacy control.
items.eligibility: Open source for any charity; pay separately for server hosting and administration.

items.name: CryptPad
items.offer: Free open-source, end-to-end encrypted documents, spreadsheets, forms, and kanban boards on the public instance or self-hosted.
items.eligibility: Open to everyone; larger managed storage quotas on the public instance are paid.

items.name: Canva for Nonprofits
items.offer: Free Canva Pro (brand kits, templates, background remover, social graphics, and reports) for up to 50 team members.
items.eligibility: Registered nonprofits, social impact organizations, and public-health NGOs verified via Goodstack.

items.name: Adobe for Nonprofits
items.offer: Free Adobe Express Premium via Goodstack plus discounted Adobe Creative Cloud Pro and Acrobat offers through TechSoup.
items.eligibility: Qualified 501(c)(3) charities, NGOs, and public libraries; operating-budget caps apply to select Acrobat offers.

items.name: Autodesk Technology Impact Program
items.offer: Donated Autodesk software subscriptions (AutoCAD, Revit, Fusion, Architecture/Engineering collections) for environmental and social-impact design.
items.eligibility: Qualifying nonprofits, NGOs, and social-impact builders using 3D design or engineering for public good.

items.name: Esri Nonprofit Program (ArcGIS)
items.offer: Steeply reduced ArcGIS mapping, spatial analysis, Living Atlas data, and training licenses for humanitarian, conservation, and community nonprofits.
items.eligibility: U.S. 501(c)(3) with qualifying NTEE code or vetted international nonprofits via local Esri distributors.

items.name: Tableau for Nonprofits (via TechSoup)
items.offer: Tableau Desktop and Tableau Prep Builder subscriptions for impact dashboards and data storytelling at a low TechSoup admin fee.
items.eligibility: Eligible nonprofits and public libraries meeting TechSoup/Tableau annual operating budget caps.

items.name: KoboToolbox
items.offer: Free mobile/offline field data-collection and survey platform (Community Plan includes 5,000 submissions/month and 1 GB file storage).
items.eligibility: Open to humanitarian, human-rights, and research organizations worldwide; higher volume tiers are paid.

items.name: OpenRefine
items.offer: 100% free open-source desktop tool for cleaning, deduplicating, and reconciling messy donor, grant, and survey spreadsheets locally.
items.eligibility: Open source for everyone; runs locally without uploading sensitive files to third-party servers.

items.name: Metabase (Open Source Edition)
items.offer: Free open-source analytics and SQL/no-code dashboards for self-hosting over your own database.
items.eligibility: Open source for any organization; managed cloud hosting and enterprise features are paid.

items.name: LinkedIn for Nonprofits
items.offer: 75% discount on LinkedIn Sales Navigator Core (major-donor/corporate outreach) and LinkedIn Recruiter Lite (staff & board hiring), plus free nonprofit resource guides.
items.eligibility: Verified legal charities complying with anti-discrimination rules; excludes universities, hospitals, credit unions, and governments.

items.name: Twilio.org Impact Access
items.offer: Free kickstart SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, voice, and email bonus units plus a 25% discount on most core Twilio programmable communications products (10% on select non-North-America products).
items.eligibility: Verified public-benefit nonprofits and social enterprises applying from the target Twilio account console.

items.name: HubSpot for Nonprofits
items.offer: 40% discount off standard list prices for net-new annual HubSpot Professional or Enterprise CRM/Marketing subscriptions (plus HubSpot's free CRM tier).
items.eligibility: Registered tax-exempt nonprofits in eligible regions (North America, Australia, New Zealand, etc.) signing up as net-new customers; Starter tier and onboarding fees excluded.

items.name: Zendesk Tech for Good
items.offer: Donated Zendesk customer-support and helpline software paired with pro bono implementation support and competitive Tech for Good Impact Awards cash grants.
items.eligibility: Registered charities and nonprofits serving underserved or vulnerable populations.

items.name: Buffer for Nonprofits
items.offer: Flat 50% discount on all monthly and annual paid Buffer social-media scheduling plans (on top of Buffer's free 3-channel plan).
items.eligibility: Registered charities and nonprofits submitting documentation via Buffer's nonprofit request form.

items.name: Hootsuite HootGiving
items.offer: Up to 60% off Hootsuite Standard and Advanced social-media management plans for verified charities.
items.eligibility: Registered charities and nonprofits validated via Goodstack or TechSoup.

items.name: Mailchimp Nonprofit Discount
items.offer: 15% nonprofit discount on paid email-marketing plans on top of Mailchimp's free starter tier.
items.eligibility: Verified 501(c)(3)s and international charitable equivalents requesting the discount via billing support.

items.name: Typeform for Nonprofits
items.offer: Permanent 40% discount on annual plans or 25% off monthly plans for interactive intake, beneficiary feedback, and donor forms.
items.eligibility: Verified nonprofits and NGOs applying through Typeform Support.

items.name: DocuSign.org
items.offer: 30% to 50% off annual DocuSign eSignature and Intelligent Agreement Management plans for grant agreements, waivers, and board resolutions.
items.eligibility: Verified nonprofits via Goodstack (annual plans only; verification stays valid for 5 years).

items.name: Zapier for Nonprofits
items.offer: 15% discount on any paid Zapier workflow automation subscription (excludes pay-per-task overages).
items.eligibility: Verified 501(c)(3)s and international charitable equivalents.

items.name: Grammarly Pro (via TechSoup)
items.offer: 30% off a 1-year Grammarly Pro subscription via TechSoup (note: Grammarly discontinued its free nonprofit program in May 2024).
items.eligibility: TechSoup-verified nonprofits on the free plan or new to Grammarly Pro.

items.name: TrustLaw (Thomson Reuters Foundation)
items.offer: Free membership connecting vetted NGOs, charities, and social enterprises worldwide with top international law firms for free legal advice, governance docs, and cross-border legal research.
items.eligibility: High-impact registered NGOs, charities, independent media, and mission-driven social enterprises vetted by Thomson Reuters Foundation.

items.name: Taproot Plus
items.offer: 100% free matching with vetted skilled volunteers for pro bono consulting projects and 1-hour strategy calls in tech, marketing, HR, accounting, and fundraising.
items.eligibility: Nonprofits, public schools, and fiscally sponsored charitable projects.

items.name: Catchafire
items.offer: Pre-scoped pro bono capacity-building projects (website audits, grant templates, financial models, branding) and 1-hour expert phone consultations.
items.eligibility: Free via foundation/corporate sponsors or via Catchafire's free community membership for eligible nonprofits.

items.name: Benevity Causes Portal
items.offer: Free nonprofit profile to unlock automated corporate workplace giving, employer donation matching, volunteer-hour grants, and corporate grants from hundreds of global companies.
items.eligibility: Registered charities in Benevity-supported countries worldwide.

items.name: Good360
items.offer: Access to donated new corporate goods (clothing, school supplies, hygiene kits, tech, furniture, and disaster supplies) for a nominal shipping/administrative fee.
items.eligibility: 501(c)(3) public charities, qualifying faith-based organizations, and schools; strict zero-resale, zero-auction, and zero-staff-perk rules enforced.

items.name: TechSoup & Goodstack (Verification Hubs)
items.offer: Free nonprofit registration hubs that verify your charitable status once to unlock 80%+ of the cloud, AI, software, and hardware programs listed above (plus TechSoup's refurbished hardware catalog).
items.eligibility: Registered charities and nonprofits worldwide (regional TechSoup Global Network partners operate across 200+ countries/territories).
